::: {.section-card}
### Data overview

The figures below summarise monthly listing volumes from Pracuj.pl and BUR in 2025, together with the longer-run evolution of BUR service provision since 2016.

**Job postings (OJP)** capture recruitment *activity* online. **Estimated vacancies (OJV)** apply a conservative rule set: explicit counts are taken at face value, “multiple positions” without a number are coded as 2, and empty fields default to 1.

```{=html}
<div class="chart-duo">
  <div class="chart-block">
    <div class="figure-caption-title"><strong>Figure 8.</strong> Pracuj.pl estimated vacancies</div>
    <div id="chart-monthly-vacancies" class="plotly-chart" role="img" aria-label="Monthly estimated vacancies on Pracuj.pl in 2025"></div>
    <p class="figure-interpretation"><strong>Interpretation.</strong> The vacancy series shows the monthly intensity of market-based recruitment captured by Pracuj.pl. It should be read as a high-quality proxy for online labour demand, particularly in white-collar, specialist, and IT occupations, rather than as a full census of all vacancies.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="chart-block">
    <div class="figure-caption-title"><strong>Figure 9.</strong> BUR training services</div>
    <div id="chart-monthly-bur" class="plotly-chart" role="img" aria-label="Monthly BUR training services in 2025"></div>
    <p class="figure-interpretation"><strong>Interpretation.</strong> BUR listings provide a view of the supply of registered training opportunities. Their volume reflects both training-market activity and public funding cycles, so the figure is most useful as a measure of available training provision rather than actual participation.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="chart-block">
  <div class="figure-caption-title"><strong>Figure 10.</strong> BUR training services by year (2016–2025)</div>
  <div id="chart-bur-yearly" class="plotly-chart plotly-chart--wide" role="img" aria-label="BUR training services by year 2016 to 2025"></div>
  <p class="figure-interpretation"><strong>Interpretation.</strong> The long-run BUR series shows strong variation across years, likely linked to EU funding cycles, pandemic disruption, and the platform’s institutional development. This supports the report’s choice to focus on within-year skill shares rather than raw volumes.</p>
</div>
<p class="notes source-note">Source: Pracuj.pl · Baza Usług Rozwojowych (BUR) · authors’ calculations on 2025 listings.</p>
```
:::
